commands.name: text
commands.value: Fertilizer is used to raise the level of nutrients in fields.  Although the fertilizer in SimFarm is natural and won't raise toxicity levels, crop rotation is an alternate method to raise nutrients.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Pesticide is used to lower the level of pests in fields.  Two sprayings will be sufficient.  Try not to spray too much or you will toxify the field.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Herbicide is used to kill off excess weeds in fields.  Two sprayings will be sufficient.  Try not to spray too much or you will toxify the field.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Fungicide is used to cure disease-infected crops.  Two sprayings will be sufficient.  Try not to spray too much or you will toxify the field.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Tractors are used for pulling plows, planters, sprayers, and trailers.  They cost $400 new and occupy one (1) space in a structure.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Plows are used to ready a field for planting.  A tractor is required for pulling.  Plows cost $200 new and occupy one (1) space in a structure.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Planters are used for planting seed in fields.  A tractor is required for pulling and seed is required for planting.  Planters cost $200 new and occupy one (1) space in a structure.  Seed costs will vary.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Sprayers are used to spray fertilizer, pesticide, herbicide and fungicide on fields.  A tractor is required for pulling and chemicals are needed for spraying.  Sprayers cost $200 new and occupy one (1) space in a structure.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Harvesters are used to harvest crops from fields.  A trailer is required for harvesting and a truck is required to carry the harvest to a silo or the town.  Harvesters cost $400 new and occupy two (2) spaces in a structure.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Trailers are used to store harvested crops while they are being harvested.  A harvester is required for pulling.  Trailers cost $200 new and occupy two (2) spaces in a structure.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Trucks are used to transport harvested crops from fields to silos or the town.  Trucks cost $500 new and occupy two (2) spaces in a structure.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Crop Dusters are used to efficiently spray large numbers of fields.  Crop Dusters cost $6000 and require an airport to be present in the town.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Small Silos are used to store harvests.  They can store one (1) harvested crop.  Small Silos cost $800.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Large Silos are used to store harvests.  They can store four (4) harvested crops.  Large Silos cost $2400.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Small Sheds are used to store machinery and seed.  They have six (6) storage spaces.  Small Sheds cost $1200.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Large Sheds are used to store machinery and seed.  They have nine (9) storage spaces.  Large Sheds cost $1440.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Small Barns are used to store sprays, seed and livestock.  Barns protect livestock well.  Livestock will not eat or drink as much if they are in a barn.  Small Barns have nine (9) storage spaces.  They cost $2250.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Large Barns are used to store sprays, seed and livestock.  Machinery can also be stored in barns, but sheds are cheaper.  Large Barns have twelve (12) storage spaces.  They cost $2520.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Water Pumps can pump water from rivers and lakes to your fields via irrigation ditches.  For further pumping, use more than one pump.  Floods can disable them.  Water Pumps cost $1000.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Windmills pump water from underground wells.  Water is pumped from Windmills through irrigation ditches to your fields.  Winds must be at least 10 MPH to work the Windmill.  They cost $2000.

commands.name: text
commands.value: Water Towers are used to store water for livestock.  They are filled when they are placed next to a full irrigation ditch.  If a Water Tower is full, water troughs are also kept full.  Water Towers cost $200.
